notes: The description says the deck went 4-0 at the Atlanta DPC and took 3rd place; the strategy says it is the exact decklist he used there (wins over Steven Lewis, Charlie Herren and Arthur Rhodes) and that Matt Berta took a version about 10 cards different to 2nd place at ComicCon. His tournament report (atlanta-dpc-the-waffle-baby, 29 July 2001) dates the DPC 28 July 2001: 2nd after the Swiss, then 3rd after losing the playoff to Brian Rippetoe; Clint Hays won.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: the list is the pre-Coruscant DPC list and has no Coruscant-set card (the post says it has no Coruscant and the Grabber will become Allegations Of Corruption later).

Starting cards as posted under 'Start (10)': Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Epic Duel, Visage Of The Emperor, Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark) and Watto's Box; these count toward the 60.
Total is 61 as published: the Interrupts header says 24, but 25 are listed. The 'Locations & Ships (5)' header line is not a card.
Posted 'Grabber' is shown as posted (type UNKNOWN): pre-Coruscant Dark grabbers include There'll Be Hell To Pay and Do They Have A Code Clearance?, and the post does not say which.

Posted 'Zuckas in MH' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Bossk in HT' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Fett in Slave 1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Mara's Stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Med. Chamber' Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'Holotheatre' Executor: Holotheatre; 'Sebbulba's Podracer' Sebulba's Podracer.

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Podrace Arena' and 'Boonta Eve Podrace' the Dark pages; 'Omni Box/It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Sniper/Dark Strike' Sniper & Dark Strike; 'Circle is Now Complete' The Circle Is Now Complete.
player_note: The post says this is the exact list he played at the Atlanta DPC, where it went 4-0.
